test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 09 Feb 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The population of a village is 68000. It increases at the rate of 5 percent in the first year and decreases at the rate of 10 percent per annum for the next 2 years. What will be the population of the village after 3 years?
solution:
**Given:**

Initial population = 68000

First-year increase = 5%

Second and third-year decrease = 10% each year

**Concept:**

Population change can be calculated using the formula: Final = Initial × (1 + change/100) for each year.

**Solution:**

⇒ After first year, population = Initial population × (1 + increase/100) = 68000 × (1 + 5/100) = 71400

⇒ After second year, population = First year population × (1 - decrease/100) = 71400 × (1 - 10/100) = 64260

⇒ After third year, population = Second year population × (1 - decrease/100) = 64260 × (1 - 10/100) = 57834

**Therefore, the population of the village after 3 years will be 57834.**
